Package com.github.crittscott.somebuckets.item

Interface FluidBucketItem

All Known Implementing Classes:
BBItem, SBItem
public interface FluidBucketItem
Marker for the mod's single-fluid-container bucket items (Big, Huge, and Source Bucket) and a shared home for the behavior and item-model state protocol they have in common.

    • getContentProperty

      static float getContentProperty(net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack stack)
      Evaluates the CONTENT_PROPERTY protocol shared by Big, Huge, and Source Bucket models.
      Parameters:
      stack - bucket stack to inspect
      Returns:
      exactly one of CONTENT_EMPTY, CONTENT_FLUID, CONTENT_MILK, or CONTENT_POWDER_SNOW

    • tryShiftClear

      static boolean tryShiftClear(net.minecraft.world.level.Level level, net.minecraft.world.entity.player.Player player, net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack stack, net.minecraft.world.phys.HitResult airHit)

      stack - the bucket stack

      Returns:
      true iff the interaction was handled (the bucket had content to clear)

      static boolean tryCrossHandTransfer(net.minecraft.world.level.Level level, net.minecraft.world.entity.player.Player player, net.minecraft.world.InteractionHand hand, net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack stack, net.minecraft.world.phys.HitResult airHit)

    • finishMilkDrink

      static void finishMilkDrink(net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack stack, net.minecraft.world.level.Level level, net.minecraft.world.entity.LivingEntity user, net.minecraft.world.item.Item item, boolean drain)
      Applies the shared side effects of finishing a milk drink for one bucket volume: the consume-item criterion and use statistic for a server player, then clearing all effects and optionally draining one unit on the server. Mirrors vanilla MilkBucketItem ordering; the ItemUseAnimation.DRINK completion path plays the drinking sound, so none is emitted here.
      Parameters:
      stack - the milk-mode bucket, already confirmed to carry a full unit
      level - acting level; state mutations run on the server only
      user - the drinking entity
      item - the bucket item, for the use statistic
      drain - true to remove one bucket volume (finite Big or Huge Bucket), false for an infinite Source Bucket
